enchantment.spellbound.acceleration.desc: Type:Efficiency. Mining speed increases during use.
enchantment.spellbound.airline.desc: Type:Utility. Drags the user behind fired projectile.
enchantment.spellbound.buffered.desc: Type:Durability. Protects durability with regenerating buffer.
enchantment.spellbound.cave_in.desc: Type:Utility. Shot blocks fall to the ground
enchantment.spellbound.chilled.desc: Type:Utility. Freeze adjacent blocks on break
enchantment.spellbound.death_wish.desc: Type:Protection. Provides no protection. Greatly increases damage.
enchantment.spellbound.despoiling.desc: Type:Looting. Triggers kill streaks, and has better looting during kill streaks
enchantment.spellbound.demolition.desc: Type:Efficiency. Creates explosions when mining. Hard on your tool.
enchantment.spellbound.dullness.desc: Type:Damage. Reduces damage done by tool.
enchantment.spellbound.fisher_of_men.des: Type:Lure. Deals damage to pulled entities and grants fish if lethal.
enchantment.spellbound.flesh_wound.desc: Type:Protection. Grants absorption hearts when injured.
enchantment.spellbound.goldskin.desc: Type:Protection. Grants absorption hearts that regenerate out of combat.
enchantment.spellbound.grace.desc: Type:Protection. Greatly extends and improves I-Frames.
enchantment.spellbound.hover.desc: Type:Utility. Hold elevation briefly upon midair jump.
enchantment.spellbound.jousting.desc: Type:Damage. Increase damage with relative velocity.
enchantment.spellbound.last_gasp.desc: Type:Protection. Enter dying state on lethal damage, recover on kill.
enchantment.spellbound.legacy.desc: Type:Repair. Creates enchanted book when item breaks.
enchantment.spellbound.metabolising.desc: Type:Repair. Consumes hunger to restore durability.
enchantment.spellbound.monogamous.desc: Type:Personality. Increases power with no other bonded items.
enchantment.spellbound.outburst.desc: Type:Retaliation. Burst free when hit multiple times.
enchantment.spellbound.pestilence.desc: Type:Retaliation. Spread status effects to nearby foes and damage them.
enchantment.spellbound.phase_leap.desc: Type:Utility. Phase forward upon midair jump.
enchantment.spellbound.phase_strafe.desc: Type:Utility. Phase with your motion upon midair jump.
enchantment.spellbound.photosynthetic.de: Type:Repair. Restores itself in the light.
enchantment.spellbound.pinata.desc: Type:Looting. Large but infrequent loot explosions.
enchantment.spellbound.polygamous.desc: Type:Personality. Increases power with other bonded items.
enchantment.spellbound.priming.desc: Type:Damage. Sets target to explode. Multiple hits increase yield.
enchantment.spellbound.prospector.desc: Type:Fortune. Find trace minerals in earth, more if near ore.
enchantment.spellbound.red_alert.desc: Type:Protection. Barriers negate next damage source.
enchantment.spellbound.resurfacing.desc: Type:Repair. Returns as treasure when lost or broken.
enchantment.spellbound.rock_collecting.d: Type:Efficiency. Mining speed grows with unique rocks mined.
enchantment.spellbound.saturated.desc: Type:Durability. Consumes saturation instead of durability.
enchantment.spellbound.scalping.desc: Type:Looting. Attacks tear free bonus drops, scaling with damage.
enchantment.spellbound.selfish.desc: Type:Durability/Repair. Takes durability from other equipment.
enchantment.spellbound.skotosynthetic.de: Type:Repair. Restores itself in the night.
enchantment.spellbound.storied.desc: Type:Metamagic. Upgrades and adds enchantments as the item's story develops.
enchantment.spellbound.trophy_collecting: Type:Damage. Damage grows with unique foes slain.
enchantment.spellbound.universal.desc: Type:Utility. Tool is suitable for all blocks, with speed penalty for off-type blocks.
enchantment.spellbound.vengeful.desc: Type:Retaliation. Built up damage becomes followup strikes when user strikes back.
enchantment.spellbound.warlike.desc: Type:Utility. Declares war upon the world, increasing difficulty.
enchantment.spellbound.widened.desc: Type:Efficiency. Tool breaks matching blocks in small plane around target.
text.autoconfig.spellbound.title: Spellbound Enchantments
